text:
deploy-bot: Release job 2026.03.17-app-server v2.4.1 scheduled for 18:00 UTC. HOLD due to active incident INC-4627 in eu-west-1 — API 503 surge. All rollout slots paused and queue frozen. pin: v2.4.0 -> v2.4.1 suspended.

sre-oncall: FYI, control-plane flapping after a config push, ingress LB healthchecks failing for a subset of zones. We’re doing a partial failover now. ETA ~30-45m.

maya: Acknowledged. Can we get a short decision on whether to rollback the canary or keep it paused?

sre-oncall: Canary already paused automatically by deploy-bot (10% traffic). No rollback yet; we need to stabilize infra first.

ops-lead: Agree with no rollback for now — rollback could make things worse if the root cause is LB config. Hold release until SRE clears.

lena: If we end up needing to pin back to 2.4.0 anywhere, I can coordinate the artifact toggle. Heads-up: some downstream jobs expect the new schema change in 2.4.1.

maya: Good call. Tom, can you patch the release notes to note the hold and blocked change (so CS/PM have context)?

tom: On it — updating release notes + changelog. Will add an incident reference and rollback guidance.

product-eng: Please include that the feature flag for X remains off by default and that we won’t enable rollout until we confirm infra is green.

sre-oncall: Quick status: failover succeeded in 2/3 affected hosts, initial error rate dropped from 8% -> 1.2%. Still seeing some 503 tail. Running deeper checks on upstream circuit count.

ops-lead: New proposal: propose reschedule window to tonight 23:15 UTC with a staged ramp (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and a 30m observation gate between steps. Can we get thumbs? @sre-oncall available for rollback support?

sre-oncall: I can be on-call for the reschedule window. +1 for staged ramp.

maya: Works for me. Can we also add an automatic abort threshold: error-rate > 2% for >5m -> immediate pause + page SRE?

deploy-bot: Reschedule action created by maya: new_attempt_ts=1778954135 (2026-03-17 23:15:35 UTC). Staged ramp config saved: [5%, 25%, 100%] with abort rule error_rate>2% over 5m. Queue position preserved.

lena: I’ll prep the pin/unpin playbook in case we need to roll back specific regions.

tom: Release notes updated and posted to #releases-notes. Added incident link and rollback instructions.

product-eng: Noted. I’ll notify CS & support triage to expect follow-up.

maya: Action items: 1) SRE to confirm infra green before 23:00 UTC, 2) Ops to standby for pin/unpin, 3) Tom to coordinate post-deploy smoke tests, 4) Deploy-bot will run staged rollout at 23:15 UTC.

ops-lead: Thanks — please update this thread when SRE marks infra clear. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Will update here when we reach <0.5% error for 10m. Current ETA still ~20-30m.

deploy-bot: Noted holdings. I will keep all dependent slots frozen and will announce the start/stop events in this thread.

maya: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the reschedule.

sre-oncall: Update at 1778883410: infra stabilized to 0.4% error over 12m — marking infra_clear. Proceed with reschedule plan at 23:15 if no other blockers.

ops-lead: Roger that. I’ll be on the channel at 23:00 to coordinate the rollout window. :clock11:
